title: City Arts Funding Review & Conflict Resolution
summary:
*   Received an update from a consultant reviewing the city's process for funding local arts organizations.
*   Heard a presentation on the Office of Dispute Resolution, a dedicated service for mediating conflicts.
*   Learned how this office helps resolve disputes concerning public projects and city policy issues.
transcript:
MINUTES OF CITY COUNCIL WORKSESSION 
OCTOBER 2,2002
Austin City Council
MINUTES
WORKSESSION
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 2,2002
The following represents the actions taken by the Austin City Council in the order they
occurred during the meeting.
The City Council of Austin, Texas convened in a Work Session on Wednesday, October 2,
2002 at One Texas Center, SOS Barton Springs Road, 3RD Floor Training Room, Austin,
Texas.
Mayor Garcia called the meeting to order at 10:13 a.m.
Briefings
1. 
Status report by the cultural arts consultant hired by the City to review the City's process
for funding arts groups.
The report was made by Lucille E. Dabney, Eduardo Diaz, and Marion A.
McCollam from Dabney & Associates.
2. 
Presentation to Council on the purpose and mission of the Office of Dispute Resolution
and the services it provides in resolving disputes regarding public projects or policy
issues involving the City of Austin.
The presentation was made by Joe Canales, Deputy City Manager, and Tracy
' Watson and Marcia Choo, Office of Dispute Resolution.
The motion to adjourn the meeting at 11:42 a.m. was approved on Council Member Wynn's
motion, Council Member Dunkerley's second on a 5-0 vote. Council Members Alvarez and
Slusher were absent.
The minutes from the work session of October 2, 2002 were approved on Council Member
Slusher's motion, Council Member Thomas' second on a 7-0 vote.
